def san(b,mv,c,rights,ep,legal=None):
    ff,fr,tf,tr,promo=mv
    p=b[fr][ff]; u=p.upper()
    if legal is None: legal=legal_moves(b,c,rights,ep)
    if u=='K' and abs(tf-ff)==2:

    else:

        s=''
        if u!='P':
            s+=u
            others=[m for m in legal if m[2:4]==(tf,tr) and m[:2]!=(ff,fr) and b[m[1]][m[0]]==p]
            if others:
                samefile=any(m[0]==ff for m in others)
                samerank=any(m[1]==fr for m in others)
                if not samefile: s+=FILES[ff]
                elif not samerank: s+=str(fr+1)
                else: s+=FILES[ff]+str(fr+1)
        elif cap: s+=FILES[ff]
        s+='x' if cap else ''
        s+=FILES[tf]+str(tr+1)
        if promo: s+='='+promo
    nb,nr2,nep=apply(b,mv,c,rights,ep)
    oc='b' if c=='w' else 'w'
    if in_check(nb,oc):
        s+='#' if not legal_moves(nb,oc,nr2,nep) else '+'
